title: Customizing option mappings with Microsoft Dataverse

facts.text: Dataverse integration must be enabled with default synchronization setup and working connection.
Feature switch Map to option sets in Dataverse without code must be enabled.
CRONUS International Ltd. demonstration data and sandbox environment required.
Visual Studio Code with AL Language extension for development.
Create temporary integration table in Business Central based on Dataverse option set schema.
Create list page using temporary table as data source and call Load procedure.
Subscribe to integration events in codeunits to enable coupling, synchronization, and field mapping.
Create integration table and field mappings to sync Dataverse options with Business Central records.
